method: TypeScript AST export/import census of apps/client/src, including direct facade/leaf symbol imports and one-hop parent tests; style strings and portal callsites extracted from actual source.
testRelationMethod: directTests import a selected symbol from the FSD barrel/leaf or are named source tests; parentTests directly import a non-test consumer (or are its same-basename test). The parent set is one hop, not a claim of complete transitive coverage.
